name: Impexinfotechindia SEO Suite
author: impexinfotechindia

sections.description:
Impexinfotechindia SEO Suite is a complete SEO plugin built by impexinfotechindia. Every feature is free and fully functional, out of the box, from one branded dashboard — including the AI writer, Autopilot and one-click optimization. There are no locked features, usage limits or upsells.

Optimize every page

  • Real-time content analysis with a 0–100 score and actionable checks as you write.
  • Live Google preview (SERP snippet) with title & description pixel/character counters.
  • Per-post SEO title, meta description, focus keyword, canonical URL, noindex/nofollow and cornerstone controls.
  • Site-wide title & meta templates with variables (%%title%%, %%sitename%%, %%sep%%, %%excerpt%%, %%category%%, and more) for every post type, taxonomy and archive.

Structured data (JSON-LD)

A clean, connected @graph: Organization / Person, WebSite (with Sitelinks Searchbox), BreadcrumbList, WebPage, Article / BlogPosting / NewsArticle, Product (WooCommerce-aware), FAQPage, and LocalBusiness with address, geo & hours.

Social

  • Open Graph and Twitter/X Cards with per-post title, description and image overrides.
  • Default share image and social profile links (feed into your schema sameAs).

Technical SEO

  • XML sitemaps — index + separate per-post-type & per-taxonomy sitemaps, with images, styled as a branded, readable page. Plus an HTML sitemap shortcode ([impex_html_sitemap]) for visitors.
  • Breadcrumbs — shortcode [impex_breadcrumbs], template tag impexseo_breadcrumbs(), and matching schema.
  • robots.txt editor and llms.txt generator (a manifest for AI assistants & answer engines).
  • Redirect manager — 301/302/307/410, regex support, and automatic redirects when a slug changes.
  • 404 monitor — logs broken URLs so you can fix or redirect them.
  • IndexNow — instantly notify Bing, Yandex and participating engines on publish.
  • Image SEO — automatic alt text for uploads and rendered images.
  • Webmaster verification for Google, Bing, Pinterest, Yandex and Baidu.
  • Page Speed — live PageSpeed Insights scores (mobile & desktop) plus a one-click optimizer that fixes alt text, external links, meta descriptions and focus keywords across your site.

Migrate in one click

Import titles, descriptions, focus keywords, canonicals, social overrides and noindex flags from Yoast SEO or Rank Math — existing Impexinfotechindia data is never overwritten.

External services

This plugin can connect to the following third-party services. Some are optional and only run when you enable the related feature or add an API key.

  1. IndexNow (only when the IndexNow feature is enabled): on publish/update, the URL of the changed content is sent to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow so participating search engines are notified instantly. Data sent: the content URL and your site’s IndexNow key. Terms of use & privacy: https://www.indexnow.org/terms

  2. Google PageSpeed Insights (only when you click “Check page speed”): the URL being tested is sent to https://www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed to return a performance score. Data sent: the page URL (and your optional API key). Terms: https://developers.google.com/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  3. AI content providers — your choice, your key (only when you configure the AI Writer and generate a post): the topic/prompt you enter is sent to the provider you selected — Google Gemini (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com), Groq (https://api.groq.com), OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai), OpenAI (https://api.openai.com) or Anthropic (https://api.anthropic.com). Data sent: your prompt/topic and settings, using the API key you provide. Review the terms & privacy of the provider you choose, e.g. Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms / https://policies.google.com/privacy ; OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use / https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy ; Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms / https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy ; Groq: https://groq.com/terms-of-use/ / https://groq.com/privacy-policy/ ; OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/terms / https://openrouter.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the impexinfotechindia-seo-suite folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Impexinfotechindia SEO in the admin menu and configure Titles, Social, Schema and Sitemap.
  4. Submit your sitemap (/impex-sitemap.xml) to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes — every feature is free and fully functional, with no usage limits or locked features. This includes all SEO tools (titles, meta, schema, sitemaps, redirects, 404 monitor, breadcrumbs, image SEO, the analyzer) and the built-in AI writer and Autopilot (you supply your own AI provider API key).

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. It outputs standard head tags, schema and sitemaps that work with any theme.

Can I use it alongside Yoast or Rank Math?

We recommend running only one SEO plugin at a time to avoid duplicate tags. Use the built-in importer to migrate, then deactivate the other plugin.

Where is my sitemap?

At yoursite.com/impex-sitemap.xml. If it 404s, visit Settings → Permalinks once to refresh rewrite rules.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2

  • Removed the unused automatic featured-image scaffolding from the AI Writer (generated posts never set a featured image; add one manually in the editor).
  • Removed inactive Video/News sitemap toggles.
  • Fixed: the Setup Wizard and dashboard module grid no longer switch off modules they don’t display.
  • Fixed: one-click “Fix” now reliably fills the meta description and focus keyword.
  • Fixed: Open Graph image alt text, XML sitemap 404 handling, and table-of-contents de-duplication.
  • Fixed a database notice shown on activation, and a deprecated argument in the author dropdown.

1.4.1

  • Changed: every feature is now free and fully functional — removed all usage limits, license checks and Pro gating. The AI writer, Autopilot and one-click optimization work without restriction.
  • Improved: the XML sitemap stylesheet is now a static asset and the HTML sitemap styles are enqueued.
  • Housekeeping: scoped time-limit extensions to the actions that need them; documented external services.

1.4.0

  • New: per-issue “⚡ Fix” buttons in the SEO analysis — resolve a missing meta description, focus keyword, image alt text or unsafe external links one at a time, or “Fix everything” at once.
  • Improved: image alt text and external-link safety are now scored, so one-click optimization visibly raises the SEO score.
  • Improved: SEO score shown as “NN/100” with a branded pill in the posts/pages list.
  • Fixed: JSON-LD schema output hardened against script-context breakout.

1.3.0

  • New: AI Writer (built in) — generate complete, SEO-ready posts from a topic using your own API key (Google Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, or OpenAI/Claude/custom). Includes an Autopilot topic queue.
  • New: generated posts are auto-filled with SEO title, meta description, focus keyword and FAQ.
  • Merged the former standalone AutoBlogger into the suite — one plugin, one menu.

1.2.0

  • New: Page Speed — real Google PageSpeed Insights scores (mobile & desktop) with Core Web Vitals, on the SEO dashboard and in the post-editor SEO box.
  • New: One-click optimize — fix missing image alt text, mark external links nofollow + new-tab, and fill missing meta descriptions/focus keywords, on a single post or across every page.
  • New: works alongside Impexinfotechindia AutoBlogger — AI-generated posts arrive pre-optimized.

1.1.0

  • New: branded XML sitemap styling — sitemaps now open as a clean, readable page in the browser.
  • New: [impex_html_sitemap] shortcode for a human-readable HTML sitemap (a second format), grouped by post type and taxonomy.
  • New: AJAX-powered admin — saving settings, adding/deleting redirects, clearing the 404 log and bulk edits no longer reload the page (toast notifications instead).
  • New: keyword density and “keyword in intro” checks in the content analyzer; focus/additional keywords now added to Article schema.
  • Improved: redesigned, fully responsive settings screens (label/control grid) and a properly styled post-editor SEO meta box.

1.0.0

  • Initial release by Impexinfotechindia.
